sentiment.rationale: The document shows strong Q4 results with revenue and GBV exceeding guidance, and management explicitly raised forward guidance: 'We expect revenue growth to accelerate to at least low-double digits in 2026.' This is a material upward revision from the prior trajectory, supported by organic product-driven momentum (Reserve Now, Pay Later, Project Y) rather than one-time items. The tone is confident and the outlook is specific, justifying a score above +0.5.

summary.revenue: Q4 2025 revenue $2.8 billion, up 12% year-over-year, exceeding the high end of guidance. Full-year 2025 revenue $12.2 billion, up 10% year-over-year.
summary.eps: Not disclosed (net income of $341 million in Q4, but EPS not explicitly stated in the document).
summary.guidance: Q1 2026 revenue expected $2.59B-$2.63B, 14%-16% YoY growth. Full-year 2026 revenue growth expected to accelerate to at least low-double digits. Adjusted EBITDA margin expected stable year-over-year.
summary.margin: Q4 2025 adjusted EBITDA margin 28% (vs 31% in Q4 2024). Full-year 2025 adjusted EBITDA margin 35%. 2026 adjusted EBITDA margin expected stable year-over-year.
key_risks: Travel is influenced by currency, macroeconomic conditions, and global events (management acknowledges unpredictability).
Cancellation rates increased approximately 1% due to Reserve Now, Pay Later (from ~16% to ~17%).
Q4 net income negatively impacted by roughly $90 million of one-time non-income tax matters.
FX tailwinds expected to fade as 2026 progresses.
key_opportunities: Reserve Now, Pay Later driving booking acceleration, expanding to new markets in 2026.
Project Y expected to deliver hundreds of millions more in revenue in 2026.
Pricing initiatives expected to drive as much revenue in 2026 as Project Y.
Major events: 2026 FIFA World Cup across 16 North American cities, Winter Olympics in Milan.
AI-powered customer support rolling out globally, AI search in testing.
Expansion into boutique/independent hotels, services/experiences, and new markets like Brazil, Japan, India.
Guest Favorites now nearly half of all bookings, driving higher satisfaction and repeat rates.

management_tone.label: confident
management_tone.justification: Management uses language like 'we're seeing increased momentum,' 'we believe the opportunity ahead is even bigger than what you're seeing today,' and explicitly raises guidance, reflecting strong conviction.
